The '''Tureen system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Tureen VI]], the origin point of the [[Soup People]], who had a reputation for making high-quality [[Soup/Legends|soup]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tureen [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square J-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
